items.name: style
items.prompt: 3D CGI animated feature film still: fully 3D-rendered cel-shaded character models with toon shading and clean ink outlines, 3D lighting with soft shadows and depth. Exactly two people in the frame: one small white-haired grandmother and one seven-year-old girl, nobody else. Dusk on the Noto coast, close framing at porch level, a three-quarter view favouring the grandmother's face. They kneel close together on cushions, knees almost touching, a small stone rice mortar between them on the wooden farmhouse porch. The grandmother holds a long-handled wooden mallet high in both hands, raised directly above the mortar at the top of its swing. The girl's small hands have just come up out of the steaming rice and rest at the rim of the mortar; she laughs softly, eyes open and bright, looking up into her grandmother's face, a dab of flour on her nose. Their eyes meet. The grandmother looks back with a gentle, knowing smile and soft, misty eyes, no tears falling, as if memorising her face, a quiet sadness under the warmth. A Japanese paper lantern hangs from the eaves, warm amber light on the grandmother; cool silver moonlight on the girl's hair and cheek. A huge full moon over the sea behind them, terraced rice paddies below, the first stars. On the porch beside them lies one spare cushion with no one on it. Restrained, precise acting, a quiet bittersweet moment from an award-winning anime feature: the last ordinary evening before everything changes. 3D CGI render, cel-shaded 3D models, volumetric light, soft depth of field, clean and crisp detail.
